module: Auxiliary controller that raises the idle of a combustion engine and connects the hydraulic pump when a hydraulic function is commanded ("electricsRaiseAndConnect" mode). It watches electrics values, imposes idleAVOverwrite/maxIdleThrottleOverwrite on the engine, connects the pump (setConnected) once the RPM is high enough and writes a state electrics value. A manual idle raise is also possible.
notes: jbeam keys (default): mode (only handled value: "electricsRaiseAndConnect"; otherwise the controller does nothing), controlledEngine ("mainEngine"), relevantPump ("pump1"), relevantElectrics (list of names), actOnPositiveElectric (true), actOnNegativeElectric (true), raisedIdleRPM (1800 RPM, converted to rad/s), raisedIdleElectricsName ("raisedIdle").
The automatic raise is canceled if electrics.values.wheelspeed > 2 m/s. The pump is only connected if an electrics value is active and the engine RPM exceeds 70% of the raised idle.
M.updateGFX = nop at export; it is replaced by the active version at init if the mode is valid.

init.desc: Reads the configuration, finds the engine and the pump and enables the control loop.

updateGFX.desc: Applies the idle raise and the pump connection (dynamically defined at init).

setState.desc: Restores the state returned by getState.
